_comment: STATIC price table for the QwenPaw cost ledger (features/cost-ledger). USD per 1,000,000 tokens. These are REPO DEFAULTS, not vendor quotes and not prices the user agreed to — the user edits this file (synced to the machine as working/cost-prices.json). Free models are $0.00 because their names/providers charge nothing per token at the time of writing; if a 'free' model ever starts charging, set its price here. No price is ever fetched from the network: this file is the only price source.

deepseek:deepseek-v4.1-flash-free.note: Free model (DeepSeek flash free tier). $0 by definition of the free tier.

jev:jev-1.13-free.note: Free model (Jev free tier). $0 by definition of the free tier.

kilo:kilo-auto/free.note: Free model (Kilo). $0 by definition of the free tier.

mosicn:nex-n2.6.note: REPO DEFAULT PLACEHOLDER — NOT a vendor quote. mosicn/nex-n2.6 is the only model in this table with a nonzero price, and its real per-token price was not verified against any vendor page. Edit these two numbers to the real price before trusting the USD totals; until then the TOKEN budget is the binding cap (see README).
